scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c dist/worker/wrangler.json && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c dist/worker/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c dist/worker/wrangler.json && wrangler deploy -c dist/worker/wrangler.json

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Optional alternative to browser setup: set a long, unique owner password as a Worker secret. When set, it takes precedence over a D1-backed owner password.

INTEGRATION_TOKEN.description: Optional separate bearer token for server-side game adapters publishing normalized events. Do not put it in browser code or overlay URLs.

TWITCH_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID from the self-hosted creator's Twitch developer application.

TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret from the Twitch developer application. Store only as a Worker secret.

TWITCH_EVENTSUB_SECRET.description: Random 10-100 character secret used to verify Twitch EventSub webhook signatures.
